subject: Temporary p50/p95 guardrail exception - evidence & conditions
messages:
From: Diana Park <diana.park@finthrive.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: temporary p95 relief + measurement window ask

Hi Rafael,

Quick background: we have an anticipated product migration next week that will cause a concentrated spike in inference traffic for our Guided Search route (same-day cutover for a subset of customers). Our SREs ran a forecast and expect a short-lived increase that will push our p95 under the current hosted API SLO for ~2-3 hours/day over a 2-week window.

We'd like to request a temporary exception for the p95 commitment on the Guided Search endpoints for a 4-week window starting 2027-06-25. Specifically:
- Scope: /v1/generate/search-guided (50% of our queries by volume)
- Target window: 06:00-10:00 ET daily (anticipated spike period)
- Request: provisional relaxation of p95 bound from 450ms -> 800ms for the named window, with regular evidence checkpoints

To move forward quickly, please advise what evidence you need (traffic matrix, replay traces, canary plan, rollback triggers). We can share our traffic forecast CSV and a DocuSign approval once scope is locked.

Also curious if Redwood can offer any temporary mitigations on your side (regional routing, provisional burst capacity, or model-variant fallback) while this migration stabilizes. We prefer a short-term operational carveout to avoid a formal SLA amendment if possible.

Appreciate a quick confirmation today — our cutover is scheduled for Friday (06/25).

Thanks,
Diana Park
Director, Engineering Ops
FinThrive Inc
attachment: traffic-matrix-csv.csv (CSV, 72KB)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Diana Park <diana.park@finthrive.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary p95 relief + measurement window ask

Diana — thanks for the heads up and the traffic CSV. We can support a provisional path but need a concrete evidence package and a short operational plan. At a high level, to approve a temporary p95 relaxation for a bounded window we need the following artifacts: 

1) Traffic & replay evidence (you provided) + request-level P95 baseline for the last 30d
2) Canary plan: % of traffic, canary start time, rollback criteria (error rate, latency threshold, user-facing error delta)
3) Telemetry retention: 90 days of request traces for the affected routes (for post-mortem)
4) Fallback policy proposal: what automatically triggers a fallback to a lower-latency model or reduced concurrency

On mitigation: Redwood can offer the following temporary measures while the exception is in place:
- Regional routing to shift non-US traffic out of the impacted US region during the 06:00-10:00 ET window
- Provisional 20% burst capacity on Dedicated nodes for 4 weeks (subject to availability)
- Automatic model-variant fallback (quantized v1 -> v1-lite) for the route if latency > 900ms for 5 consecutive minutes

If you can provide the canary plan + baseline P95 by EOD tomorrow we can provision the burst capacity and draft a 30-day temporary amendment. I've attached our SLO evidence checklist to make it straightforward.

I'll loop in Legal/CS for the amendment if you want DocuSign. 

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachment: slo-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 88KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Internal: FinThrive temporary p95 exception — risk & guardrails

Rafael / Karthik / Laura — quick internal read on this FinThrive ask. I reviewed the traffic CSV; risk is moderate given volume during peak hours. My proposed internal decision: approve a timeboxed exception with these hard conditions:

1) Duration capped at 4 weeks; automatic expiry unless extended in writing.
2) Canary: start at 2% traffic for 2 days, then step to 5%/day, not exceeding 10% at any time. Canary must be observed and signed off by FinThrive SRE + our oncall.
3) Monitoring & rollback automation: if request error rate increases by >0.5pp or p95 > 900ms for 10 consecutive minutes, auto-fallback to v1-lite and immediate notification to both parties.
4) Evidence checkpoints: joint review at day 7 and day 21 with shared dashboards (we need FinThrive to grant viewer access to the relevant Datadog dashboards).
5) Telemetry: FinThrive must provide trace IDs and replay artifacts for any incident; retention for 90 days.
6) Legal to sign a temporary amendment (I recommend a short addendum that documents scope/timeframe/remediation).

Karthik — can you confirm we can toggle regional routing and enable model-variant fallback on that route without a deploy? Laura — legal will need the amendment template; I'll draft the operating checklist.

If all agree I support a conditional approval — better to have the runbooks and automation in place before cutover.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Diana Park <diana.park@finthrive.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary p95 relief + measurement window ask

Diana — following internal review, Redwood can approve a provisional, tightly-scoped exception for the Guided Search route as follows: 

- Scope: /v1/generate/search-guided for FinThrive production traffic only (no sandbox/test traffic)
- Window: daily 06:00-10:00 ET
- Duration: 4 weeks starting 2027-06-25; automatic expiry 2027-07-23 unless extended in writing
- Temporary p95 target: 800ms for the scoped window only; p50 commitment remains unchanged

Conditions (must be met before cutover):
1) Canary plan uploaded and confirmed by both SRE teams (initial 2% traffic for 48 hours, then staged ramp)
2) FinThrive grants viewer access to the shared dashboards (link below) for evidence checkpoints
3) DocuSign-signed temporary amendment (we've drafted a PDF)
4) Our automation will enable model-variant fallback if p95 > 900ms for 10 consecutive minutes

Attachments: slo-evidence-checklist.pdf, temp-slo-amendment-draft.pdf
Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finthrive/temp-amendment
DocuSign: https://docusign.example/FT-1947-amendment

If you confirm the canary plan and grant dashboard access by EOD tomorrow we will provision the provisional burst capacity and enable routing rules for the window. We'll also schedule the day-7 checkpoint with your SREs.

Thanks — we'll monitor closely and escalate to execs if anything unexpected shows up.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
